title: ARC-KV: Amortizing Anchor Search for Reconstruction-Based KV Cache Compaction
abstract: arXiv:2609.36835v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long-context large language model inference is bottlenecked by KV caches that grow linearly with sequence length. This burden is especially severe for long, reusable context prefixes, whose cache must serve many downstream queries. Reconstruction-based methods such as Attention Matching achieve strong downstream task performance with compact KV caches. However, iterative anchor search dominates the compaction cost of OMP-based Attention Matching. This motivates our selective amortization principle of learning a reusable anchor-selection policy across contexts while retaining context-specific reconstruction. In this work, we propose ARC-KV, a novel reconstruction-based KV cache compaction method that follows this principle. To this end, we first train a value-aware indexer to select real-key anchors in a single scoring pass. ARC-KV then applies convex-hull-constrained key merging and fits an attention-mass bias and compact values against

translated_title: ARC-KV：面向基于重构的KV缓存压缩的锚点搜索摊销方法
translated_abstract: 长上下文大语言模型推理的瓶颈在于随序列长度线性增长的KV缓存。对于长且可复用的上下文前缀，这一负担尤为严重，因为其缓存必须服务于大量下游查询。基于重构的方法（如注意力匹配）能够以紧凑的KV缓存实现出色的下游任务性能。然而，迭代式锚点搜索主导了基于OMP的注意力匹配的压缩成本。这促使我们提出选择性摊销原则：跨上下文学习一个可复用的锚点选择策略，同时保留针对特定上下文的重构。在本工作中，我们提出了ARC-KV，一种遵循该原则的新型基于重构的KV缓存压缩方法。为此，我们首先训练一个值感知索引器，通过单次评分即可选出真实键锚点。ARC-KV随后应用凸包约束的键合并，并拟合注意力质量偏置与紧凑值……
tldr: ARC-KV训练值感知索引器学习可跨上下文复用的锚点选择策略，将迭代式锚点搜索进行摊销，并结合凸包约束的键合并，大幅降低基于重构的KV缓存压缩成本，同时保持下游任务性能。
en_tdlr: ARC-KV amortizes iterative anchor search by training a value-aware indexer that learns a reusable cross-context anchor-selection policy, combined with convex-hull-constrained key merging, drastically reducing the cost of reconstruction-based KV cache compaction while preserving downstream task performance.
